units.source_text: 处理完仁太郎的丧事后，第一件要面对的事儿就是儿媳妇阿民的去留。

en.t: After Nintaro's funeral was over, the first matter they had to face was whether his wife Tami should stay or leave.

units.source_text: 阿民生了一个儿子，在仁太郎卧病在床期间，她替丈夫做了所有的农务。

en.t: Tami had borne a son, and while Nintaro lay ill in bed she did all the farm work in her husband's place.

units.source_text: 倘若现在让她离开，照顾孩子自然不成问题，但是家里的农务就难以支撑了。

en.t: If they made her leave now, looking after the child would of course be no problem, but the farm work at home would become impossible to sustain.

units.source_text: 因此，阿住计划等七七四十九天之后，帮阿民招赘一个丈夫，如儿子还在世的时候一样，由她负责家里的负担。

en.t: So Asumi planned to wait until the forty-nine days of mourning had passed, then bring in a husband for Tami and have her carry the household burden just as she had when her son was alive.

units.source_text: 阿住已经物色好了一个招赘的人选——仁太郎的表弟与吉。

en.t: Asumi had already found a candidate to marry into the family: Nintaro's cousin Yokichi.
